The cubic phase HoAl4Cu (space group F-43m, No. 216) has a unit cell containing 24 atoms—Ho4Al16Cu4—distributed over three independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived CrystalNN analysis identifies 12-coordinate Al centers with a close-packed-like local arrangement, while Cu and Ho each show 16-vertex coordination environments. The geometric neighbor graph is three-dimensional and spans all 24 sites. Validated polyhedron-sharing relations include corner- and face-sharing between Al 12-vertex and Cu 16-vertex polyhedra, and corner, edge, and face sharing among Cu polyhedra.
